items.target: このじてんしゃはふるくないです
items.reviewNote: Forms brief item (e): negative half of the ふるい minimal pair, held on the same じてんしゃ frame; the ふるくないです form appeared nowhere in the index or wave 1. Constructed.

items.target: このこうえんはにぎやかです
items.note: As a predicate, a な-adjective takes です directly with no な — にぎやかです (nigiyaka desu). The な appears only before a noun: にぎやかなこうえん (nigiyaka na kōen).
items.reviewNote: Forms brief item (b): affirmative half of the fixed-frame な-adjective cycle (same frame as the next card). Constructed.

items.target: このアプリはよくないです
items.note: いい (ii) is the one irregular い-adjective: its negative is よくないです (yokunai desu), never いくない (ikunai), which is what the regular い→くないです pattern would predict.
items.reviewNote: Forms brief item (c): よくないです in a real sentence — the index carded it only as the bare form 'Not good.' with no sentence. Constructed.

items.target: おかしはいかがですか
items.note: Thingはいかがですか (thing wa ikaga desu ka) is the polite way to offer food or drink. More polite than どうですか (dō desu ka).
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue, verbatim. Only the bare vocabulary item いかがですか was carded; the full offering sentence from the dialogue was not.

items.target: このかばんはおおきくないです
items.note: Negative of an い-adjective: the final い drops and くないです attaches — おおきい (ookii) → おおきくないです (ookikunai desu).
items.reviewNote: Forms brief item (a): negative half of the fixed-frame い-adjective cycle, held on the same かばん frame so the くないです transformation is the only change. Also closes the おおきい-negative gap from item (e). Constructed.

items.target: いいえ、さむくないです
items.scene: answering whether it's cold in London
items.reviewNote: Exercise 3B item 1 B-line, negative い-adjective answer following the printed example いいえ、あつくないです (which is carded). Elliptical, hence the scene.

items.target: きょうのてんきはわるいです
items.note: わるい (warui) is the opposite of いい (ii) and, unlike いい, conjugates regularly: わるくないです (warukunai desu).
items.reviewNote: Vocabulary coverage for わるい — Word Power word appearing in no sentence anywhere in the index or wave 1. Constructed from ch. 3/10 vocabulary (きょう, てんき).

items.target: このコップはきれいじゃありません
items.note: The trap: きれい (kirei) ends in い but is a な-adjective, not an い-adjective — noun form きれいなコップ (kirei na koppu), negative きれいじゃありません (kirei ja arimasen). きれいくない (kireikunai) does not exist. It means both 'pretty' and 'clean'; here it is 'clean'.
items.reviewNote: Forms brief item (d), the きれい trap card. きれいな noun-modifying sentences and the affirmative already exist (きれいなはな, このはなはきれいです, はい、きれいです), so per the brief this targets the negative, where the trap actually bites. Also shows the 'clean' sense for the first time. Constructed.

items.english: Is the ocean in Okinawa beautiful?
items.target: おきなわのうみはきれいですか
items.reviewNote: Exercise 6A item 2 (cue おきなわの うみ、きれいです completed per the example pattern). おきなわ and うみ were carded only as vocabulary.

items.target: こちらは6,500えんです
items.ttsText: こちらはろくせんごひゃくえんです
items.hint: shopkeeper's polite こちら (kochira), not これ (kore)
items.reviewNote: Speaking Practice 2, verbatim (shopkeeper offering a cheaper bowl). Hint added because the English alone would also produce the chapter-4 pattern これは〜えんです (kore wa ~en desu); this line shows polite こちら for an item.
items.note: こちら (kochira) is the shopkeeper's polite word for これ (kore), the same service register as こちらです (kochira desu) from Lesson 9.

items.english: It is not very cold today.
items.target: きょうはあまりさむくないです
items.note: あまり (amari) + negative works with adjectives exactly as it does with verbs in Lesson 9 (あまりみません (amari mimasen)): 'not very...'.
items.reviewNote: Adverb coverage: あまり + adjective negative, taught in this chapter's notes. All existing あまり cards (ch. 9) are verb negatives; no あまり + adjective example existed. さむくないです itself is covered by wave 1, so あまり is the new element here. Constructed.

items.target: はい、たかいです

items.target: きょうとのおかしです

items.target: このワインはやすくないです

items.reviewNote: Gap-closing batch: やすくないです appeared nowhere. Hint added because the natural English 'not cheap' could otherwise produce たかいです (takai desu). Constructed.

items.target: このみせはあたらしくないです
items.reviewNote: Gap-closing batch: あたらしくないです appeared nowhere (affirmatives exist: かとうさんのうちはあたらしいです, このパソコンはあたらしいですか). New noun to vary the frame. Constructed.

items.target: このじてんしゃはふるいです
items.note: ふるい (furui) describes things, never people.
items.reviewNote: Forms brief item (e): ふるい existed only as a noun modifier (ふるいとけい), never as a predicate, so this is the affirmative half of a minimal aff/neg pair with the next card. Constructed.

items.target: そのワインはたかいですか

items.target: おちゃをどうぞ
items.note: The pattern Thingをどうぞ (thing o dōzo) is how you offer something to someone: "please help yourself to..."
items.reviewNote: Target Dialogue opening line (also Notes 1 example), verbatim. The extraction carded bare どうぞ back in chapter 0 but never this offering pattern with を.

items.target: いいえ、しずかじゃありません

items.target: このえいがはおもしろくないです

items.target: このカメラはやすいです

items.target: ここでまちます
items.note: まちます (machimasu) is the verb behind the set phrase ちょっとまってください (chotto matte kudasai) from Frequently Used Expressions.
items.reviewNote: Vocabulary coverage for まちます — listed in the chapter's vocabulary but appearing in no sentence anywhere (only inside the fixed expression まってください). Constructed from ch. 8/9 grammar (で place of action, ここ).

items.target: このとけいはちいさくないです
items.reviewNote: Gap-closing batch: ちいさくないです appeared nowhere in the deck. Negative half of the ちいさい minimal pair on the held とけい frame. Constructed.

items.reviewNote: Gap-closing batch: あたたかくないです appeared nowhere (affirmatives are the weather small-talk pair). Applied to おちゃ to show あたたかい beyond weather. Constructed.

items.target: とてもおいしいです

items.reviewNote: Gap-closing batch: わるくないです appeared nowhere. Held on the same きょうのてんき frame as the affirmative card (きょうのてんきはわるいです) so the transformation is the only change. Constructed.

items.target: いいえ、べんりじゃありません

items.english: What kind of place is Odaiba?
items.target: おだいばはどんなところですか
items.reviewNote: Vocabulary coverage for おだいば — chapter vocabulary word in no sentence anywhere. Doubles as the missing question for wave 1's answer card おもしろいところですよ, whose scene names exactly this question. Constructed per the Exercise 9 pattern.

items.english: It's a convenient app, isn't it?
items.target: べんりなアプリですね
items.reviewNote: Gap-closing batch: べんりな + noun appeared nowhere (only predicate uses). Mirrors そのアプリはべんりですか so the learner meets both forms of べんり on the same noun. Constructed.

items.english: It's an interesting place, you know.
items.target: おもしろいところですよ
items.scene: answering what kind of place Odaiba is
items.reviewNote: Exercise 9 item 2 final line (cue おもしろい, completed per the example きれいなところですよ). Kept despite the carded example because this variant is the い-adjective + ところ form, grammatically distinct from the carded な-adjective version; the parallel な-adjective item (にぎやかなところですよ) was skipped as a near-identical variant. Elliptical, hence the scene.
items.note: よ presents this as news for the listener — you have been there and they have not. Contrast きれいなところですね, which would assume you are both looking at it. The particle is formally introduced in Lesson 12.

items.target: いいえ、すずしくないです

items.reviewNote: Gap-closing batch: しずかな + noun appeared nowhere (only predicate uses). Same exclamation pattern as きれいなおかしですね, on the レストラン the unit already asks about (あのレストランはしずかですか), so the な transformation on familiar ground. Constructed.

items.english: It's a bit expensive, isn't it?

items.note: Softly declining a price while shopping. ちょっと (chotto) hedges the complaint and ね (ne) softens it further.

items.target: このこうえんはにぎやかじゃありません
items.note: Negative of a な-adjective: じゃありません attaches straight to the adjective, no く form — にぎやか (nigiyaka) → にぎやかじゃありません (nigiyaka ja arimasen). Same ending as noun + じゃありません from Lesson 2.
items.reviewNote: Forms brief item (b): negative half of the fixed-frame な-adjective cycle on the held-constant こうえん frame. Also closes the にぎやか-negative gap from item (e) (only ゆうめい, べんり and しずか negatives existed). Constructed.

items.target: シドニーはすずしいですか
